test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 02 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the name of the centrally sponsored scheme related with literacy that was launched by the Government of India in March 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New India Literacy Programme**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **New India Literacy Programme** is the centrally sponsored scheme related to literacy launched by the Government of India in March 2023.
 
• This scheme aims to address the challenges of adult literacy and promote lifelong learning.
 
• The programme focuses on several key areas including foundational literacy and numeracy, critical life skills
